build_Field_for_text: create a Field object to tokenize and numericalize sequential text data into PyTorch tensors
build_Field_for_non_sequential: create a Field with sequential=False to handle non-sequential numerical data without tokenization
build_NestedField_for_char_embeddings: create a NestedField with a character-level nesting field to build character embeddings for words
build_LabelField_for_classification: create a LabelField to handle classification labels with automatic non-sequential and target settings
build_RawField_with_pipeline: create a RawField with preprocessing and postprocessing pipelines for custom data transformation
